name: Text on Core Text
description: The live half of SuiteModel's text contract, reached as SuiteServices.text through LiveText: measures spans on Core Text into one advance per grapheme (ligatures split evenly, an emoji whole), ascent and descent, and names the fallback family; lists the Mac's font families with their faces; and draws placed glyphs at their origins and angles into an sRGB MediaFrame. It measures and draws only: line breaks, alignment and type on a path are creative-core text-engine's, so an app Model measures here, lays out in core, and draws here.
technology: Swift 6, Core Text and AppKit, macOS 26
